What is Private Limited Company Registration? Private limited company registration is the process of registering a business under the Companies Act 2013. This gives the business a separate legal identity other than its owners. This registration requires the business to meet certain requirements and involves processing through certain documentation. How many directors and shareholders does a private limited company need? A private limited company should have a minimum of 2 directors (maximum up to 15) and a minimum of 2 shareholders (maximum up to 200). One of the directors should be a resident of India, having lived in the country for at least 120 days in the previous financial year. Is there a minimum capital requirement for Pvt Ltd company registration in India? No, the Companies Act amendment that came into effect in 2015 requires no minimum paid-up capital to register your business as a private limited company. How long does private limited company registration take? The entire registration process is done on the SPICe+ system, and with complete and accurate documents at hand, it usually takes 7 to 10 days. How do I register a private limited company using SPICe+? There are several steps you need to proceed through on the SPICe+ system on the MCA V3 portal. These steps include Part A and Part B, along with e-MOA and e-AOA filing, and more. What are the documents required for private limited company registration? The documents you need for private limited company registration are ID proof and PAN of directors Address proof of office Registered office documents (ownership proof, rent agreement, or NOC) Each director’s DIN, DSC, AOA, and MOA Can a private limited company use a residential address as its registered office? Yes, a private limited company can use a residential address as the registered office address for business registration (ensure that you provide accurate address proof). What are the corporate tax rates applicable to a private limited company? There are different tax rate slabs for private limited companies: 25% for companies having turnover up to ₹400 crore 22% under the concessional Section 115BAA regime 15% under Section 115BAB for eligible new manufacturing entities What is the difference between MOA and AOA? The Memorandum of Association (MOA) lists the company’s registered office, its objectives, and scope, while the Articles of Association (AOA) list the rules to manage and run the company. What are the main advantages and disadvantages of a private limited company? Advantages: Limited liability for the directors and owners Easy fundraising support No minimum paid-up capital requirement Disadvantages: Compulsory annual audit More regulatory obligations to meet High compliance costs What compliance is required immediately after incorporation? The immediate compliance requirements after company incorporation are: Appointment of first auditor within 30 days through form ADT-1 File form INC-20A within 180 days Hold first board meeting within 30 days Can a foreign national be a director in an Indian private limited company? Yes, a foreign national can become a director in a private limited company in India. However, one of the directors of the company has to be an Indian resident, having lived in the country for a minimum of 120 days in the past fiscal year. Is GST registration mandatory during private limited company registration? No, GST registration is not compulsory during company registration. But, if you wish to register for GST, you can do that via form AGILE-PRO-S during registration time, or even at a later stage. Can a private limited company be converted from an existing proprietorship or partnership? Yes, you can change the business structure of your present proprietorship or partnership firm to a private limited company. For this, you have to proceed through the required documentation, asset transfer, and other formalities. What happens if a company doesn't file its annual compliance on time? If your company misses annual compliance obligations, then it can incur penalties. If the non-compliance happens continually, then you run the risk of getting your company struck off the registration. Should I use a professional private limited company registration service or file it myself? You can file the registration yourself. However, there are a lot of steps and the paperwork and portal technicalities involved in company incorporation. Any unorganized process or filing with a lack of knowledge can delay it for weeks. Therefore, having a professional private limited company registration service helps get company incorporation easily and quickly.

A private limited company registration is the process of registering a company under the Companies Act 2013. This provides businesses with a separate legal identity from the business owners. A Pvt Ltd Company Registration has become a highly popular business structuring form in the present times because it provides limited liability protection to the owners and legitimacy to the investors.

This guide will take you through all the procedural and documentation requirements to register your company as a private limited company. These include eligibility norms, the SPICe+ system process, government fees, and corporate tax rules and compliance to follow after registration. This guide also covers advantages and disadvantages that business owners gain.

For someone who is seeking expert guidance and support when registering their private ltd company, Services Plus provides in-depth guidance and can handle all the paperwork and registration on their behalf with complete private limited company registration services.

A private limited company is a business unit registered with the Registrar of Companies (RoC) under the Companies Act of 2013. This business structure makes the company a separate legal entity from its owners and shareholders. This means that the business can own property and assets, take business loans, and get into contracts independently of the owners and shareholders.

A private limited company registration requires at least 2 owners or shareholders, up to a maximum limit of 200. It also requires having at least 2 directors, one of whom should be a resident of India having lived in the country for at least 120 days during the previous financial year.

Being a separate legal entity means that if there is a business loan on the company and it struggles to repay it, then borrowers cannot target owners’ and shareholders’ private assets to cover that debt. In such a scenario, their risk is limited to only what they have invested in the firm. This is one of the biggest reasons why more and more people chose this business structure.

I've walked founders through this decision more times than I can count, and before you commit, it helps to weigh the full advantages and disadvantages of private limited company registration honestly. Let's start with what's genuinely good about this structure.
Limited liability protection: Personal assets of shareholders stay separate from company debts.
Separate legal entity: The company exists separately from its owners, so it doesn't get dissolved automatically if a director resigns or passes away.
No minimum capital requirement: As per the 2015 amendment to the Companies Act, there's no compulsory requirement for any minimum paid-up capital anymore.
Easier access to funding: Private limited companies can issue shares and raise funds from investors, venture capital, or angel investors.
Professional credibility: Vendors, banks, and larger clients usually show more trust in a registered Pvt Ltd company.

These include filing annual returns with the RoC, annual audit of accounts, maintaining statutory registers, and holding board meetings, irrespective of how big or small the revenue is.
